meta.description: Parent taxonomy for mapping specific Achiote reference pantry families into broad global food-memory coverage clusters before densifying records.

provenance.source: Derived from committed reference pantry fixture coverage tags after cache-key normalization.
notes: This file is taxonomy architecture, not proof that every family is well-populated.
Specific dish families remain retrieval leaves; clusters are parent buckets for balanced database population.
Population should thicken clusters across regions, food forms, mechanisms, naming systems, and diaspora paths rather than multiplying fake family names.
Current coverage axes are the first required scaffold, not a completeness claim about world food.

Everything means open-world expansion: every newly observed food form, ecology, ingredient base, technique, naming system, ritual context, migration path, and locality must be either mapped into an existing axis or added as a new axis/value.

clusterPolicy.requiredCoverageAxesScope: Current requiredCoverageAxes come from global-coverage-matrix and are the first validation scaffold, not a final or exhaustive ontology of world food.
populationOrder: cover every current global coverage axis value while treating the axis list as expandable
raise thin families to target record floor
add region, diaspora, naming, ingredient, and sensory variants under existing families before creating new families
create a new family only when no existing family or parent cluster can retrieve the memory without semantic distortion

clusters.label: Liquid comfort and beverages
clusters.description: Drinkable memories, warm or cold comfort liquids, porridges-as-drinks, and hydration rituals.
populationStrategy: Keep the parent cluster broad enough for retrieval and analytics.
Populate with specific child dish families, regional records, diaspora records, naming variants, sensory mechanisms, and substitution contexts.
Do not encode coverage bands or QA contexts in dishFamily or region cache keys.
